metadata.title: MedOrbits Services Catalogue
metadata.description: What MedOrbits offers: informational guidance and tools for health-course aspirants. The seed entries are proposed drafts that must be confirmed by the business before publication.
metadata.positioning: Informational guidance and discovery tools. Not an admission authority, consultancy placement guarantee, or substitute for official sources.
metadata.draftNote: Seed services are proposals inferred from the data files in this project. All are inactive drafts until the business confirms what it actually offers.

key.note: Matches testimonials.serviceUsed values where applicable; scholarship_information is new and should be added there.

whatItDoesNotInclude.note: Must always state limits; cannot be empty.

shape.label: string or null
shape.url: https URL or site path or null

businessConfirmedBy.note: Name of the person who confirmed the business really offers this service.

dataRules: Every service must have a unique id, key and slug.
Only list a service the business actually provides; a service becomes publishable only after businessConfirmedBy and businessConfirmedAt are set.
whatItDoesNotInclude must never be empty and must state that no admission, job, funding or outcome is guaranteed.
Never invent prices, discounts, durations, success rates, partner names or testimonials.
pricing.amount requires currency and billingFrequency or model 'one_time'; free services must set model 'free' and amount null.
Do not describe a service as 'official', 'authorised' or 'affiliated' unless that relationship is documented.
relatedExamIds, relatedCourseIds and relatedFaqIds must reference existing records.
Claims about guidance must be informational and must point users to official sources.
Paid services must show price, what is included and refund terms before any payment flow.
Do not collect personal data in this catalogue; any intake form must follow a separate privacy policy.
verifiedAt and verifiedBy must be null until verified, and set together.
The active field controls display only; seed entries stay active false until confirmed.

displayRules.disclaimer: MedOrbits provides informational guidance and does not replace official admission authorities. No admission, employment, funding or outcome is guaranteed.
